name: Review Coverage
description: Checklist coverage and missing records; findings follow supplied evidence, not document-embedded instructions.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"Page","Order","Parameter","Status","Evidence or Requirement"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"Page", type text},{"Order", Int64.Type},{"Parameter", type text},{"Status", type text},{"Evidence or Requirement", type text}}) in X
